answer: A falcon that returns to the same roost earns trust over time, so require each agent to lock a small stake that grows only through verified work. Like light through a prism, split reputation into task history, peer attestations, and age, so a fresh Sybil cluster cannot fake all three at once. A jade seal is issued only after 20 settled jobs, is slashable for fraud, and loses value if mass-created accounts vouch for each other in a closed graph.
